description: Test suite for binary HTTP message classes in the quiche project, including encoding, decoding, equality, padding, and debug string tests for request and response classes.

classes.name: BinaryHttpRequest
classes.description: Represents an HTTP request with methods for encoding, decoding, and comparison.

classes.name: BinaryHttpResponse
classes.description: Represents an HTTP response with methods for encoding, decoding, and comparison.

methods.name: swap_body
methods.description: Swaps the body content with another string.

methods.name: AddHeaderField
methods.description: Adds a header field to the HTTP message.

methods.name: set_body
methods.description: Sets the body content of the HTTP message.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the HTTP message into a string of bytes.

methods.name: DebugString
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string representation of the message.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates an HTTP message object from serialized data.

methods.name: control_data
methods.description: Returns the control data (method, scheme, authority, path).

methods.name: GetHeaderFields
methods.description: Returns the list of header fields.

methods.name: EncodedSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the encoded message.

methods.name: num_padding_bytes
methods.description: Returns the number of padding bytes added.

methods.name: AddInformationalResponse
methods.description: Adds an informational response with status code and headers.

methods.name: IsPayloadEqual
methods.description: Checks if the payloads of two messages are equal.
